correctness.rationale: Exact count-state probabilities follow from weighted edge counts; exponential-clock embedding preserves the jump chain. Bounded jumps, quadratic variation of order 1/N and Gronwall prove the finite-time fluid LLN. Two ODE first integrals yield all terminal root cases including the rate threshold; the pathwise inequality X(T)-Y(T)-Z(T)<=U_A<=X(T) passes from finite-time to terminal and then to large N, with B,C terminal densities zero. Full-distribution exact checks for small labeled graphs, symbolic first-integral identities and nine ODE cases were replayed. The proof, not Monte Carlo, establishes the general limit.

value.rationale: The precise rate-dependent extensive jamming transition and continuously varying exponent 2b/a provide a natural kinetic observable on a graph family capable of perfect matchings. For rho=3 the smallest initial part can survive macroscopically while two larger parts vanish, distinguishing rate selection from static matching feasibility. The exact rational finite recurrence gives experimental and computational benchmarks. The contribution is the evaluated limiting phase diagram and stochastic terminal justification, not a generic chemical master equation or a tiny special-case count.
